R1.method: Counted number of solids in STEP file

R2.method: Checked annulus volume in y=[0,4] to ensure plate existence and thickness

criteria.condition: Face plate at least 4 mm thick with solid material all around the central bore

R2.why: The check for R3 (bore) passes on a control cube because it only checks if material is absent; however, R2's annulus volume check correctly fails on the cube. But R2 itself is flawed as it uses an arbitrary ring radius (15mm) to infer thickness/material rather than checking the specific geometry of

R3.method: Measured material volume within the 22.5mm bore cylinder through y=[0,4]

criteria.condition: Central bore diameter 22.5 mm through the face plate

R3.why: The check only verifies that material volume in the bore region is near zero. As seen in the control run, this passes even if no part exists, meaning it fails to verify that a bore actually exists within a face plate.

R4.method: Measured diameters of 4 holes at (+-15.5, 30 +- 15.5) via void cylinder probing along Y

criteria.condition: Four motor screw holes, diameter 3.4 mm

R5.method: Intersection volume with clearance box [-21.5, 21.5] x [-48, 0] x [8.5, 51.5]

criteria.condition: Motor clearance: nothing in -21.5 <= x <= 21.5, -48 <= y <= 0, 8.5 <= z <= 51.5

R6.method: Checked z_min >= 0 and measured screw hole diameters at (+-25, 25) via Z-axis probing

criteria.condition: Two vertical screw holes, diameter 5.5 mm, at (x, y) = (+-25, 25)

R7.method: Checked BBox x[-35, 35], z_max <= 55 and mass = volume * 0.00124 g/mm^3
